(1) KCET (Karnataka Common Entrance Test / UGCET): conducted by the Karnataka Examinations Authority (KEA), Karnataka's equivalent of AP/Telangana's EAPCET, admitting into Engineering/Pharmacy/Agriculture/Veterinary degree programmes on 2nd PUC marks plus KCET rank; architecture admission additionally needs a NATA score per one source (not independently confirmed as the complete rule). The 2026 cycle's exam date is GENUINELY CONFLICTING across secondary sources - most report 23-24 Apr 2026 (plus a 22-Apr Kannada test), but one Careers360 report says KEA revised this to 25-26 May 2026 after removing the original dates from its own site, and another lists 18 Apr 2026 - all three flagged, none independently resolved. (2) DCET (Diploma Common Entrance Test): also KEA-conducted, but - IMPORTANT, distinguishing it from AP/Telangana's POLYCET - DCET is NOT a direct-diploma-entry exam; it is solely for lateral entry of existing Diploma holders into 2nd-year B.E./B.Tech (and reportedly 1st-year Architecture under a Lateral Entry Scheme). 2026 exam date (23-May-2026) was consistent across two sources, but the application closing date (3 vs 4 vs 10 Apr 2026) and counselling-round dates (three mutually inconsistent reports) could not be reconciled - flagged unverified.
